license_required.quote: Any person who engages or who offers to engage in the practice of architecture or provides interior design services as a certified interior designer without holding a currently valid license or certificate as required by this act

issuing_authority.quote: There is hereby established an Architects Licensure Board

name.quote: There is hereby established an Architects Licensure Board

type.quote: one member who shall be a certified interior designer, and seven members, all of whom shall be architects

moral_character_required.quote: Any individual of good character may apply for a certificate under this act to engage in the provision of interior design services as a certified interior designer.

degree_required.value: A professional degree in interior design or architecture from an accredited school
degree_required.quote: A professional degree in interior design or architecture from an accredited school.

accrediting_body.value: national accrediting body or approved by the board
accrediting_body.quote: Any educational institution with an academic program in architecture or interior design services accredited by a national accrediting body or approved by the board.

degree_level.quote: A professional degree in interior design or architecture from an accredited school.

school_approval_basis.quote: accredited by a national accrediting body or approved by the board.

credential_pegged.quote: An applicant for a certificate under this section shall submit evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has met the eligibility requirements to take a national certification exam approved by the board

required.quote: At least two years of practical experience under the direct supervision of a nationally certified interior designer or architect.

experience_source.quote: At least two years of practical experience under the direct supervision of a nationally certified interior designer or architect.

duration.quote: At least two years of practical experience under the direct supervision of a nationally certified interior designer or architect.

kind.quote: At least two years of practical experience under the direct supervision of a nationally certified interior designer or architect.

exams.name: National certification exam approved by the board (Council for Interior Design Qualification)
exams.notes: The board may, at its discretion, adopt the examination and recommended grading procedures adopted by the Council for Interior Design Qualification.
exams.quote: the board may, at its discretion, adopt the examination and recommended grading procedures adopted by the Council for Interior Design Qualification on the effective date of this subsection.

interval_years.quote: Each certificate shall contain the name of the individual to whom it was issued and the individual's certification number and shall be valid for a period of two years.

required.quote: As a condition of biennial renewal, a certified interior designer shall provide the board with documentation of successful completion of a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education, half of which shall be in the subject areas of health, safety and welfare.

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education, half of which shall be in the subject areas of health, safety and welfare.

period_years.quote: As a condition of biennial renewal, a certified interior designer shall provide the board with documentation of successful completion of a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education

topical_requirements.quote: half of which shall be in the subject areas of health, safety and welfare.

available.quote: The board may issue a certificate to provide interior design services as a certified interior designer in this Commonwealth, without examination, to any individual who is licensed, registered or certified as an interior designer in another state or country where the qualifications required are equivalent to those required in this Commonwealth.

requirements.value: Equivalent qualifications to Pennsylvania; CIDQ certificate is prima facie evidence. Board may also issue certificate to someone who practiced >10 years in another jurisdiction upon a satisfactory practical exam. Architects may obtain certificate without examination or additional fees.
requirements.quote: The possession of a certificate from the Council for Interior Design Qualification shall be prima facie evidence that the individual meets the qualifications required in this Commonwealth.

exists.quote: There is hereby established an Architects Licensure Board which shall consist of the Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs, the Director of the Bureau of Consumer Protection in the Office of Attorney General, or the director's designee, two members who shall represent the public at large, one member who shall be a certified interior designer, and seven members, all of whom shall be architects

national_certification.quote: The possession of a certificate from the Council for Interior Design Qualification shall be prima facie evidence that the individual meets the qualifications required in this Commonwealth.

regulatory_model.quote: An individual who is licensed, registered or certified as an interior designer in another jurisdiction may offer and provide interior design services in this Commonwealth without first obtaining a certificate.

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue licenses to individuals who have qualified to engage in the practice of architecture and certificates to individuals who have qualified to engage in interior design services as certified interior designers under the provisions of this act.

is_mandatory.quote: An individual who is licensed, registered or certified as an interior designer in another jurisdiction may offer and provide interior design services in this Commonwealth without first obtaining a certificate.

title_protection.quote: "Certified interior designer." An individual who is certified under this act to provide interior design services.

scope_protection.quote: An individual who is licensed, registered or certified as an interior designer in another jurisdiction may offer and provide interior design services in this Commonwealth without first obtaining a certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Bribery, fraud, misstatement or misrepresentation in the application for a certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Bribery, fraud, misstatement or misrepresentation of fact by an applicant in connection with this application for a license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing interior design services in violation of any provisions of this act or its rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of architecture or providing interior design services as a certified interior designer in this Commonwealth in violation of any provisions of this act or the rules and regulations promulgated thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a certificate revoked, suspended, or disciplined in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice architecture or a certificate to provide interior design services as a certified interior designer revoked or suspended or having other disciplinary action taken by the proper licensing or certificating authority of another state, territory or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing interior design services in violation of board-established standards of professional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of architecture or providing interior design services as a certified interior designer in this Commonwealth in violation of the standards of professional conduct established by rules and regulations promulgated by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting unauthorized practice of interior design services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting any individual, partnership, association or corporation to engage in the practice of architecture or providing interior design services as a certified interior designer in violation of any provisions of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Bribery, fraud, deceit, recklessness, gross negligence or incompetence in the provision of interior design services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Bribery, fraud, deceit, recklessness, gross negligence or incompetence in the practice of architecture or in the provision of interior design services as a certified interior designer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of a certified interior designer's number in violation of section 704
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of an architect's seal in violation of section 505 or the use of a certified interior designer's number in violation of section 704.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or a crime involving moral turpitude. Conviction shall include a finding or verdict of guilt, an admission of guilt or a plea of nolo contendere.

definition_quote.value: The rendering or offering to render services in the preparation and administration of documents, including drawings, schedules and specifications which pertain to the design intent and planning of interior spaces, including furnishings, layout, fixtures, cabinetry, lighting and device location and type, finishes, materials and interior construction not materially related to or materially affecting the building systems. The term does not include the practice of architecture.

The term does not include the practice of architecture.

seal_required.quote: A certified interior designer shall ensure that all interior design documents, including drawings, schedules and specifications prepared by the certified interior designer, bear the signature and certificate number of the certified interior designer and the date when each document was signed by the certified interior designer on each document's title block.
